confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not checked against live listings or booking pages. Restaurant, coffee and beer anchors rest on typical Finnish price levels and are moderately reliable. Hostel and hotel anchors are less certain because July demand in Rovaniemi is seasonal and varies by property. Cocktail and wine anchors use the local beer-to-drink price relationship as a fallback. FX: the RBA exchange-rate statistics table, as shown in search-result excerpts, lists 0.6947 for 2026-10-16. Other RBA excerpts (overview and homepage) show 0.6955 for 2026-10-15. I could not open the RBA page to confirm the 16 October figure directly, so the 15 October value is the corroborated fallback.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Finnish regional tourism towns and Lapland resort-town pricing, adjusted for July high-season demand. Not a direct comparison with a specific live city dataset.
